warning.titlePre: Range Rover Velar D250 Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your Velar D250 has the 3.0-litre AJ300D Ingenium diesel — fitted across the entire L560 generation from 2017 — timing chain tensioner wear is a well-documented pattern on this engine family. We replace timing chains, injector seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.
The petrol Ingenium engines in the Velar range use different components and don't share this specific timing chain pattern — they're generally considered more reliable in this area.
warning.source: Source: shared Ingenium diesel family pattern per VRF-landrover-velar.md. Petrol Ingenium engines explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF
